name: Mizuho (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mizuho town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised leaf-like drop.
history: Municipal flag of Mizuho, a town in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 April 1965.

features.role: Mizuho town emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised leaf-like drop
